response.title: validate_currency should reject unsupported codes
response.body:
`validate_currency` currently accepts anything.

It should:
- strip whitespace and upper-case the code
- accept only EUR, USD, GBP, PLN
- raise `ValueError` for anything else
- return the normalised code
